Nicole Carpenter / Aftermath :

In a default judgment, a US federal judge awards Nintendo of America $4.5M in damages in its lawsuit against a Reddit moderator who sold pirated Switch games   —  The court entered a default judgement in favor of Nintendo  —  Nintendo of America was awarded $4.5 million in damages in its lawsuit …
